div.div:
One discount definition per event; edits do not rewrite purchased snapshots.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
name: text [NN]
discount_kind: text [NN]
percentage_bps: integer [?]
fixed_minor: bigint [?]
starts_at: timestamptz [NN]
ends_at: timestamptz [NN]
max_redemptions: integer [NN]
is_enabled: boolean [NN]
default true
all_ticket_types: boolean [NN]
default true
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, event_id)
CK1: (discount_kind = 'percentage' AND percentage_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND
percentage_bps IS NOT NULL AND fixed_minor IS NULL) OR (discount_kind = 'fixed' AND
fixed_minor > 0 AND fixed_minor IS NOT NULL AND percentage_bps IS NULL)
CK2: ends_at > starts_at AND max_redemptions > 0
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Eligible ticket types; composite FKs prevent cross-event discounts.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
campaign_id: uuid [FK NN]
ticket_type_id: uuid [FK NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (campaign_id, ticket_type_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(campaign_id, event_id) -> campaign(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(ticket_type_id, event_id) -> ticket_type(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Human code and separate opaque campaign-link token.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
campaign_id: uuid [FK NN]
code_normalized: text [UQ NN]
link_token_hash: text [UQ NN]
is_enabled: boolean [NN]
default true
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (code_normalized)
UQ2: (link_token_hash)
UQ3: (id, event_id, campaign_id)
CK1: code_normalized = upper(btrim(code_normalized))
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(campaign_id, event_id) -> campaign(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One active redemption allowance per hold; released/consumed history retained.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
campaign_id: uuid [FK NN]
promo_code_id: uuid [FK NN]
hold_id: uuid [FK NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'active'
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
discount_snapshot: jsonb [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, event_id, campaign_id)
CK1: status IN ('active','consumed','released')
CK2: expires_at > created_at
CK3: jsonb_typeof(discount_snapshot) = 'object'
PARTIAL UQ: (hold_id) WHERE status = 'active'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(promo_code_id, event_id, campaign_id) -> promo_code(id, event_id, campaign_id) [1 parent
/ 0..* children]
(hold_id, event_id) -> checkout_hold(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Immutable successful-order attribution; refund never deletes/replenishes it.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
campaign_id: uuid [FK NN]
reservation_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
order_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
discount_minor: bigint [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (order_id)
UQ2: (reservation_id)
CK1: discount_minor >= 0
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(reservation_id, event_id, campaign_id) -> promo_reservation(id, event_id, campaign_id)
[1 parent / 0..1 children]
(order_id, event_id) -> ticket_order(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
